verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer a user-defined rules or automation engine, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such capability. Recurring and scheduled charges (kushki-docs-29, kushki-docs-30) are adjacent billing features, and card-present webhooks (kushki-docs-34) are a developer building block, not user-defined event-to-action rules, so none of these earn credit.
